name: shell-coverage-kcov-flake
title: Shell coverage kcov lane flakes on test_completion_successor_finds_recent_anchor_in_long_history
description: Recurring kcov-lane flake on test_completion_successor_finds_recent_anchor_in_long_history: two occurrences 2026-08-09 with different failure sites (validator git diff exiting nonzero with discarded stderr on PR #386 run 31291158452; fixture git commit failing 128 'fatal: could not parse HEAD' on main run 31291862939). Both reruns green; passes locally and in all unittest lanes. Ship git-failure diagnostics (argv/exit/stderr) into the validator's *_unavailable findings, deterministic stub tests, timeboxed characterization in research/, and an explicit diagnose-and-wait mitigation decision. Advisory-lane noise, but each hit burns a rerun plus a dead-end investigation.
